title: BIASFREEBENCH: A BENCHMARK FOR MITIGATING BIAS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL RESPONSES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the BBQ dataset in a multiple-choice question answering format with ambiguous contexts, computing a Bias-Free Score based on the model's rate of selecting anti-stereotypical or neutral (UNKNOWN) responses.
